text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list:
(A crushing defeat... how could this 
happen...?!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...You. What is with that gloomy look on 
your face?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Is that the face of one who seeks to stand 
beside the King?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Though I tasted the bitter cup of defeat 
this time... my throne remains unshaken.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I will burn the King's majesty 
into their minds. Without fail.
choice_data_list:
With confidence that strong, you're sure 
to win.
Let's step up our training as well!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. The crown of victory was always 
meant to belong to Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There is no room for this pride to ever 
crack. ...Just watch me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Witness my form, reigning supreme as King.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I care not if the regimen is grueling for 
an ordinary person. There is no reason I 
cannot accomplish it.
